title: MadeTool
description: A tool a person made on openvibe.tools (plan 2026-11-13 §AD.7 step 2; the owner, 11-15: "people should be able to make their own tools … AI or Codes to generate them … model selection and OpenVibe.exchange"). GET /api/v1/made-tools/:id answers one, GET /api/v1/made-tools (public ones) and /api/v1/made-tools?mine=1 (the caller's own) list them; POST makes one and PATCH changes it (each change is the next version); DELETE removes it. KIND says how it runs. A prompt tool is instructions and a model: a run sends the instructions and the input to the model through OpenVibe.AI as the person who runs it (on_behalf_of: their free allowance, their Vibes or their own keys pay, never the tool's maker), and the answer is result.data (output.kind json, checked against output.schema) or result.text (output.kind text). A code tool is one JavaScript entry pinned by its sha256 that runs as a skill-runner function job (JSON in on stdin, at most 64 KiB of JSON out, no spawn, write or eval, the network that NET allows) placed by OpenVibe.Run on HOSTING: openvibe (OpenVibe's runner), mine (the owner's own Link nodes) or shared (nodes that serve others). INPUT is the JSON Schema (2020-12) a run's input must match. VISIBILITY: private (the owner alone sees and runs it), unlisted (anyone with its id runs it; never listed or indexed) or public (listed, searchable, runnable by anyone signed in). RUN.PATH is POST /api/v1/made-tools/{id}/run, body { input }, answered with tools.run@1. A CHAIN tool (1.1.0) runs other tools in order: each step names a tool (a catalogue id or a made tool's mtl_ id) and its input, whose values may be templates: "{{input.<field>}}" (the chain's own input) or "{{steps.<n>.<path>}}" (an earlier step's result data, or text for a text result); a value that is only a template takes the value as it is, a template inside other words is written in as text. The chain's answer is the last step's result (output_from last) or every step's (all). A chain runs as the person who runs it: every step is one run with their own credentials and paid as that run is. RULES this schema enforces: a prompt tool has prompt and no code; a code tool has code and no prompt; a chain tool has chain and neither; json output has a schema.

id.description: The tool's id. It never changes.

name.description: Their display name when the tool was read, for people.

slug.description: A short name, unique among the owner's tools (summarize-email), for addresses and an agent's tool list.

summary.description: One plain sentence: what the tool does. Agents read it to decide when to use the tool.

kind.description: prompt: instructions run by a model through OpenVibe.AI. code: a JavaScript entry run as a skill-runner function job. chain (1.1.0): other tools run in order, each step's input from the chain's input or an earlier step.

input.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) of a run's input: an object schema.

kind.description: json: result.data, checked against schema. text: result.text.

schema.description: JSON Schema of result.data. Required when kind is json.

prompt.description: A prompt tool's instructions and model; null for a code tool.

instructions.description: What the model is told to do with the input (the system message). The input follows as JSON.

model.description: An OpenVibe.Exchange model id, or auto (the router picks the cheapest model that does the job).

code.description: A code tool's entry; null for a prompt tool.

sha256.description: The entry file's SHA-256; a run refuses any other bytes.

entry.description: The entry file's path in its source (tool.js).

source.description: Where the file is kept: a git.openvibe.codes repository or a Media object.

net.description: The network a code tool may reach: none, the public internet (through the egress guard), or OpenVibe's own sites only. A prompt tool reaches no network (deny).

hosting.description: Where a code tool runs: OpenVibe's runner, the owner's own Link nodes, or nodes shared with others. A prompt tool runs on OpenVibe (openvibe).

version.description: 1 when made; each change adds one.

runs.description: How many times it has run (all callers).

chain.description: A chain tool's steps (1.1.0); absent or null for the other kinds.

tool.description: A catalogue tool id, or a made tool's id

name.description: What this step does, for people

input.description: The step's input: literal values, or templates {{input.<field>}} and {{steps.<n>.<path>}}

output_from.description: The chain's answer: the last step's result (default), or every step's
